# Framework Desktop — Modular Mini-ITX AI/Gaming PC (AMD Ryzen AI Max)

**Category:** Desktop computer (Mini-ITX / mini PC)

**MSRP:** Starting at $1,099 (Max 385, 32GB)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Processor options | Ryzen AI Max 385 (8c/16t, 3.6GHz base/5.0GHz boost, 32MB L3); Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (16c/32t, 3.0GHz base/5.1GHz boost, 64MB L3) |
| Integrated Graphics | Radeon 8050S (Max 385) or Radeon 8060S (Max+ 395), RDNA 3.5 |
| Memory | Soldered LPDDR5x-8000, unified: 32GB (Max 385), 64GB or 128GB (Max+ 395); 256-bit memory bus, up to ~256GB/s bandwidth |
| Storage | 2x M.2 NVMe slots (PCIe), up to ~16TB combined |
| Networking | Wi-Fi 7, 5Gbit Ethernet |
| Expansion Slot | PCIe x4 (Mini-ITX standard) |
| Rear I/O | 2x USB4, 2x DisplayPort, 1x HDMI, 5Gbit Ethernet |
| Front I/O (Expansion Cards) | 2x user-selectable slots: USB-C (USB 3.2 Gen 2), USB-A (USB 3.2 Gen 1), MicroSD, SD, Storage (250GB/1TB), Ethernet (2.5Gbit), Audio (3.5mm) |
| Mainboard Form Factor | Standard Mini-ITX |
| Power Supply | FlexATX, 400W |
| CPU Cooling | 120mm fan, swappable (Cooler Master Mobius 120, Cooler Master Mobius 120p ARGB, or Noctua NF-A12x25 HS-PWM) |
| Case | 4.5L, tool-free panels (thumbscrews + magnets); black or translucent side panel |
| Front Panel | 21 customizable, swappable color tiles (3D-printable) |
| Dimensions | 96.8 x 205.5 x 226.1mm |
| Accessories | Optional carrying handle |
| Operating System | Bring your own — Windows 11 Home/Pro or Linux |
| Warranty | 1-year limited |

## Notable Features

- Uses AMD's Ryzen AI Max ("Strix Halo") APU — a laptop-class chip with discrete-level integrated graphics and massive unified memory bandwidth
- Up to 128GB of unified LPDDR5x memory enables running large local LLMs (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B) directly on the desktop
- Standard Mini-ITX mainboard, FlexATX PSU, and 120mm fan mount — compatible with the broader PC parts ecosystem, and the mainboard can be dropped into any standard Mini-ITX case
- Framework's Expansion Card system carries over from the laptops, letting you configure the two front port slots
- Tool-free case design (thumbscrews and magnets) with easily accessible M.2 storage and swappable CPU fan
- Customizable 21-tile front panel for cosmetic personalization; tile designs are open-sourced for 3D printing
- Only non-repairable/upgradeable components are the CPU and soldered memory, due to bandwidth requirements of the 256-bit memory bus
